description: Creates an empty rows x columns table on a slide (batchUpdate createTable) and returns its objectId in the reply. Fill cells with set_text / insert_text using row_index + column_index (0-based); restructure later with edit_table. Position/size are in points; omitted geometry lets the API pick a centered default. Cell styling (borders, background) goes through batch_update updateTableCellProperties.

columns.description: Column count (the API allows at most 20 columns at creation).

object_id.description: Optional custom object id for the new table.

page_object_id.description: The slide's object id to place the table on (from list_slides).

presentation_id.description: The presentation id — the long id from the URL (docs.google.com/presentation/d/<presentationId>/edit) or from create_presentation output.

rows.description: Row count (the API allows at most 20 rows at creation).

name: create_table
title: Create a table
